Functional Specifications
Introduction

Background
PNB is the market leader for unit trust business in Malaysia. PNB’s objective is to provide excellent unit trust services, innovative solutions for their customers and agents as well. The scope of work is to enhance  current .net version of FCIS application to FCIS 14.4.0.0.0 base product with functionalities required for PNB.
Organization of the Document
The first chapter of this document gives an introduction with brief background and organization of the document.  Subsequent chapters cover the details of the actual enhancements.
Acronyms and Abbreviations

Requirements Summary
The enhancements scoped in the document are relating to the Financial Planning Enhancement that were customized for PNB as part of .net enhancements. The Details are covered in the Traceability Matrix section. The summary of requirements is as below:
Financial Plan Allocation Bucket
Financial Plan Maintenance

Auto-Unit movement between FP and UT Buckets

Financial Plan Allocation Bucket
Requirements Overview
It is required to enhance the existing financial plan bucket with all the new fields that are customized in current FCIS .net version. ASNB has launch special products in which Variable Priced (VP) and Fixed Priced (FP) funds are marketed together as a Financial Plan.
Investment into Financial Plan must consume units from separate allocation bucket. Any outflows from FP fund used in a Financial Plan must add units back into Financial Plan bucket and UT bucket based on defined percentage. This percentage should be parameterized.

Existing Functionality
NA
Assumptions
The allocation limit set-up is not applicable for Variable Priced funds.
Functional Approach

Maintenance
A new Transaction category “Financial Plan” will be introduced in FCIS system.
This new Transaction category will be made available for users to maintain in the existing “Holding limit for investor and transaction categories” screen under fund rules.
If the FP fund is unlimited, e.g. ASB, there is no need to maintain separate allocation for Financial Plan bucket. Kindly Refer below FS for info about these fields.
“FS_FCIS_14.4.0.0.0$ASNB_R1_Fund_Rule.docx”

Two new fields - “Use Financial Plan Bucket for Outflows” and “Financial Plan Bucket Percentage for Outflows” will be added under “Shares Characteristics” sub-screen of Fund Rules.
The drop-down “Use Financial Plan Bucket for Outflows” will be used to indicate whether outflow from the fund to impact the Financial Plan bucket.
The “Financial Plan Bucket Percentage for Outflows” field will be used to maintain the Percentage of UT outflow units to be added into Financial Plan bucket. This percentage will be applied to each UT outflow in the said fund.
If “Use Financial Plan Bucket for Outflows” is maintained as “Yes” then:
“Financial Plan Bucket Percentage for Outflows” will be a mandatory field. User can maintain as any number between 0 and 100, where, 100 means 100% into Financial Plan bucket and 0 means 100% into UT bucket and. Decimals will not be allowed in this field. In case, this field is maintained as “90”, then 90% of UT outflow will go into Financial Plan bucket and 10% into UT bucket and so on.

User must define allocation for Financial Plan bucket under Fund-Holding limits maintenance.
User can change the option to use Financial Plan bucket for outflows as well as the linked percentage at any time, but it will be applicable from next Fund Rule Effective Date as per existing system feature.
If the option to use Financial Plan bucket is selected as Yes, all UT outflows in the fund will use the percentage defined irrespective of whether, the fund is part of any Financial Plan or if the involved UH having Financial Plan investment or not.
System will first calculate the number of units to be added into the Financial Plan bucket based on the Percentage and the remaining units will go into the UT bucket.

Financial Plan Maintenance
Requirements Overview
ASNB has launched special products in which Variable Priced (VP) and Fixed Priced (FP) funds will be marketed together as a Financial Plan. Each Financial Plan to consist of one Variable priced and one Fixed priced fund.

There must be a provision to define percentage of amount invested in VP and FP fund out of total amount invested in the Financial Plan. There must be a provision to define minimum and maximum investment into Financial Plan.
Investment into Financial Plan must consume units from separate allocation bucket, wherever applicable.
Existing Functionality
NA
Assumptions

NA
Functional Approach
Maintenance
A new screen “Financial Plan Maintenance” will be introduced, where user can define the Financial Planning Solution Package features.
The following parameters can be defined in the Financial Plan Rules screen:

Financial Plan ID – Unique identifier for Financial Plan
Financial Plan Effective Date – Date from which the Financial Plan Rules are effective.
Financial Plan Short Name – Short name for Financial Plan
Financial Plan Full Name – Full name for Financial Plan
Minimum Investment Amount – Minimum investment amount in Financial Plan. System will validate against this limit during transaction save in the Financial Plan. This minimum investment amount will override Fund Minimum Investment Amount, if any, in case of Financial Plan transactions.

Maximum Investment Amount – Maximum investment amount in Financial Plan. System will validate against this limit during transaction save in the Financial Plan. This maximum investment amount will override Fund Maximum Investment Amount, if any, in case of Financial Plan transactions.
Investment Step Amount –The investment amount in Financial Plan must be in multiples of Step Amount. This investment step amount will override Fund level step amount, if any, for Financial Plan transactions.
Financial Plan Enabled – To enable/disable Financial Plan
Variable Fund ID – The Fund ID for variable priced fund.
Variable Fund Percentage – The percentage for Variable Fund in case of Financial Plan transaction. System will automatically apply this percentage on investment amount in case of Financial Plan transaction. Decimals will not be allowed in this field.

Fixed Fund ID – The Fund ID for fixed priced fund.
Fixed Fund Percentage – The percentage for Fixed Fund in case of Financial Plan transaction. System will automatically apply this percentage on investment amount in case of Financial Plan transaction. Decimals will not be allowed in this field.
Each Financial Plan must consist of one VP and one FP fund, if the user maintained otherwise, system will throw an error “Each Financial Plan must have one VP and one FP fund”.
The sum of Variable and Fixed Fund Percentage must be equal to 100. System validation will be added to enforce this condition.
During save, system will validate and throw error message “Financial Plan Bucket not maintained for FP fund” if FP fund without Financial Plan bucket is used in a Financial Plan.

The Financial Plan screen will use Maker/Checker concept.
In case, any Financial Plan is not required, user can amend the Financial Plan rules and set the “Financial Plan Enabled” field as “No”. This field can be amended back to “Yes” if Financial Plan needs to be allowed again in future.
This new screen will support View, Amend, Delete and Authorize operations.
The following fields can be amended by user in the Amend mode:

Agent-Wise Financial Plan Limit Setup:
Requirements Overview

Each agent to have own allocation for the FP fund used in Financial Plans. There should be a provision to define allocation over a time-period.
Existing Functionality
NA
Assumptions
NA

Functional Approach
Maintenance
A new screen – Financial Plan Quota - Detail will be introduced to allow users to maintain the Agent-Wise limit setup for Fixed Price funds used in Financial Plans.
There will be a provision to define the period for which the limit setup is valid.
There will also be a Rule Effective Date which will be used to specify the date from which the Financial Plan quota limit will be applicable. This Rule Effective Date will always be more than or equal to the Start Date and less than the End Date.

Each fund will have only a single record with a particular Start Date, End Date and Rule Effective Date. If there is another record for the same fund, there should be no overlap between the dates.
The system will allow limit setup only for Fixed Priced funds.
If one FP fund is used in multiple Financial Plans, the limit setup will apply across the Financial plans in which the that particular FP fund is used.
For e.g.
ASM is used in both FP1 and FP2.

If Limit setup of 1 Million is done in ASM for MBB from 01-Jan-2019 till 31-Dec-2019, any subscription from MBB in either of FP1 or FP2 between 01-Jan-2019 and 31-Dec-2019 will be validated against the maintained limit.
The new screen will have Maker/Checker concept and the setup will be applicable only after the record is authorized.
The summary screen for Financial Plan Quota Set Up will be provided and will support View/Amend/Delete/Authorize options.
All the previous Rule-Effective date records will appear in the summary screen.
There will be a provision to Amend the limit set-up. The user can change the Start/End Date as well as the Quota allowed for an Agent. However, the amendments will be subject to below conditions:

Start Date can be changed only if the current Application date is not past the Start Date
End Date can be extended any time before the End Date is reached. The End Date can also be reduced if the new End Date is more than the current system date.
The Agent-Wise limit can be increased or decreased. During Save time, the system will validate if the new limit is less than the number of units already utilized and if it is so the system will throw error otherwise it will allow the limit to be decreased. The system will not validate the limits at the time of setup. The validation will happen only at the time of Transaction capture.
During EOD batch activity, if the utilization is more than the new limit, then the EOD will get aborted. For example, if the Limit for ASNB was amended from 12000 to 10000 and before EOD the utilized units reaches to 11000 then the EOD activity will get aborted.
New Agents can be added before or after the Start date has begun but the Rule Effective Date for these agents will always be more than the existing Rule Effective Date.

Agents can be deleted from a record only when the Start Date has not begun. If the Start Date has begun then the Agents cannot be deleted, they can only be suspended, applicable from a new Rule Effective Date for the specified period. Suspending means that those Agents cannot perform any fresh subscriptions, but Quota already utilized remains intact. This will allow users to Un-Suspend these Agents anytime, if required.
There can only be one active setup for a Fund and Agent combination at a time considering the latest rule which will be based on the Rule Effective Date.
After the End date has passed, the system will archive the quota record for future references.
In case of any unutilized units at the end of the period, the units will not be carried forward and users will need to maintain a fresh record for any limit setup in future.
If no maintenance done for an Agent in a particular FP fund, the agent will not be allowed to perform subscription in any Financial Plan involving that FP fund.

At the time of Financial Plan subscription, the system will calculate the total units subscribed in Financial Plan for that FP fund by the agent in the defined period and raise error – Total Financial Plan units subscribed in <FP Fund> exceeding the Quota limit set for the Agent. The system will not consider any outflows for calculations.
There will not be any screen for displaying the Agent-Wise utilization in FCIS. The utilization can be monitored through BO reports.

Auto-Unit movement between FP and UT Buckets
Requirements Overview
To set the Max Allowed unit to be maintained automatically in UT and Financial Plan buckets for outflows due to Redemption.

When the outflows have been set as “Yes”, any redemptions will reduce Units Utilized in UT bucket and remain no changes in Units Utilized for Financial Plan bucket.
Units Utilized in PB bucket will only show the total units utilized by the PB transaction, not the additional value due to Redemption transaction.
Existing Functionality
NA
Assumptions

The term Redemption in the requirement refers to all outflows and not specifically to Redemption transaction.
Functional Approach
Maintenance
The UT (non-EPF) and PB buckets will be impacted for each outflow as per the percentage defined at the fund level. This is as per the existing system functionality.
A new EOD batch process – “Move Allocation from UT to PB” will be introduced to move unit allocation and utilization from the UT (Non-EPF) bucket to the PB bucket.

The above-mentioned batch process will calculate the total outflow from PB bucket for the current application date based on the percentage maintained at the fund level.
The derived units will be deducted from the corresponding UH category and Race combination Max Reg Units and Units Utilized of UT bucket and added into the corresponding UH category and Race combination Max Reg Units and Units Utilized of PB bucket.
The units utilized in the PB bucket can be negative during day but will be positive after the EOD process is completed. The scenario is described in the illustration sheet – Scenario1.
This approach will lead to reduction in the Max Registered units of UT bucket and increase in the Max Registered units of PB bucket over a period. Users need to monitor the Unit utilization and take manual remedial action if the Max Registered units of UT buckets drops below user acceptable levels.
There is an unlikely possibility that the UT unit utilization can go negative. The scenario is described in the illustration sheet – Scenario2. This scenario needs to be handled manually by users.

Pre-EOD check will be introduced to check if the UT unit utilization goes negative.

Financial Plan Subscription Transactions:

Requirements Overview
Subscription into Financial Plan allowed only from OTC.
Subscription into Financial Plan to create subscription into VP and FP fund in the percentage of the total investment amount as per the maintenance at the Financial Plan maintenance level.
Financial Plan Subscription transaction in FP fund to use Financial Plan bucket allocation, wherever applicable. Financial Plan Subscription can be performed by ASNB as well as Agents.
Existing Functionality

NA
Assumptions
Financial Plan Subscription is allowed only for UT policy. Financial Plan subscription is not applicable for EPF and loans.
There will be no impact on Transaction cancellation as without initial VP transaction, Financial Plan subscription will not be allowed.
In case the allocation fails during EOD, any refund to UH needs to be operationally handled.

Functional Approach
Transaction
A new screen “Subscription Plan - Detail” will be introduced under Transaction Input menu to capture Financial Plan investment transactions.
The new screen will be MyKad enabled.
Financial Plan transaction will be allowed in a VP fund only if the Initial has been already performed in the VP fund.

If user tries to capture a Financial Plan transaction where VP funds doesn’t have any Initial transaction, then system will raise error as “Financial Plan transaction allowed only if the Initial transaction has been performed in VP fund”
All the validations applicable to Normal UT subscription will be applicable for Financial Plan subscriptions as well. For e.g., AMLA and UBB related validations.
There will be no such check on FP funds, even if no initial investment done in FP fund, Financial Plan transaction will be allowed to be captured.
In case of Financial Plan subscription, the total investment will be split into VP and FP fund.
In order to avoid rounding issues, system will first determine the VP amount based on the VP fund percentage maintained at Financial Plan maintenance level. The derived amount will then be rounded to nearest integer. The FP fund amount will be calculated by subtracting the VP amount from total investment amount. For e.g., if total investment amount is 5,001 and percentage is defined as 60:40 for VP and FP fund respectively, system will derive the VP amount as 3,001 (60% of 5,001 = 3000.60 = 3001 post rounding) and FP amount as 2,000.

Upon Financial Plan transaction authorization, system will automatically generate two transactions – one in FP fund and one in VP fund based on the allocation percentage defined at the Financial Plan level.
The auto-authorization feature will be applicable for Financial Plan subscriptions. It will follow the limits defined for Subscription at the Agent/Branch level as per the existing system functionality.
The Financial Plan transactions will consume units from Financial Plan Allocation bucket of the respective fund, wherever applicable. Refer Illustrations to explain the above logic.
The Fee will be applied on the VP fund transaction as per the existing ISC set-up. Product Team to maintain the Fee-setup for Reference Type “Financial Plan” (same as for “Normal Purchase”).
Add Info fields mapped to Subscription screen will be applicable for “Financial Plan” subscription screen as well.

In case VP fund is historical priced, where both subscription transactions will be allotted upon authorization.
In case VP fund is forward-priced fund, the system will try to allot FP fund transaction immediately. If FP transaction fails to allot, the entire Financial Plan subscription will be rejected. If FP transaction is successfully allotted, there will not be any restriction on FP fund redemption by UH.
The forward-priced VP transaction will get allotted during EOD batch process as per existing functionality. In case, the VP transaction fails to allot in batch, the linked FP transaction to be reversed manually by users. There will not be any automatic handling for such cases.
In case of Cheque-based transaction, both the VP and FP transactions will be “Provisionally Allotted”. Both the transactions will be confirmed or reversed upon the Cheque clearing/bounce as per the existing system functionality.
In case the allocation of either transaction fails, the entire Financial Plan transaction will be rejected.

A separate summary screen will be developed for handling Financial Plan subscriptions. The new screen will support View, Delete, Authorize and Reverse function.
Reversal of Financial Plan transaction can be done by front teller only on the same day, different day reversal can be done from FMG module. This is as per existing system feature.
Reversal of Financial Plan transaction will result in reversal of both the underlying VP and FP transactions.
If the units are insufficient in any of the underlying funds in Financial Plan Transaction, the reversal of entire Financial Plan transaction will fail.
The individual transactions generated as part of Financial Plan subscription will be restricted from appearing in the existing Subscription summary screen.

Pre-EOD check will be added to find any unauthorized Financial Plan subscription before EOD.
Upon click of save of the transaction a confirmation page will be generated by the system same as explained in Subscription FDD.

Redemption Transactions:
Requirements Overview
Redemption of units from FP fund used in Financial Plan to add units into UT and Financial Plan bucket based on defined percentage.
Existing Functionality

NA
Assumptions
System will not track whether the units being redeemed are originally normal UT or Financial Plan units.
Functional Approach
Transaction

Redemptions to be captured from existing screens.
During UT redemption, system to check if the indicator to use Financial Plan bucket for Outflows is set as “Yes” at the Fund level.
If the flag is set as “Yes”, system to determine the number of units to go into Financial Plan bucket based on the Percentage defined at the fund level.
The units arrived to be added into the Financial Plan bucket, remaining units to be added into the UT bucket.
In case the flag is set as “No”, all the units to go back into the UT bucket.

Units will continue accumulating in the Financial Plan bucket even if the sum of Units Consumed and Units Available exceeds the total bucket size. Users to move excess units manually if they wish to move to any other bucket.

Switch Transactions:

Requirements Overview
Switch-out of units from FP fund used in Financial Plan to add units into UT and Financial Plan bucket based on defined percentage.
Switch-In of units into FP fund used in Financial Plan to consume units from UT bucket.
Existing Functionality
NA

Assumptions
System will not track whether the units being Switched are originally normal UT or Financial Plan units.
Functional Approach
Transaction
Switch transactions to be captured from existing screens.

During UT switch-out, system to check if the indicator to use Financial Plan bucket for Outflows is set as “Yes” at the Fund level.
If the flag is set as “Yes”, system to determine the number of units to go into Financial Plan bucket based on the Percentage defined at the fund level.
The units arrived to be added into the Financial Plan bucket, remaining units to be added into the UT bucket.
In case the flag is set as “No”, all the units to go back into the UT bucket.
For Switch-In leg, the units will be consumed from UT bucket.

Refer Illustrations to explain the above logic.
